biotools.summary: Colora is a Snakemake workflow for complete chromosome-scale de novo genome assembly using Pacific Biosciences HiFi, Hi-C, and optionally Oxford Nanopore Technologies reads. It is designed to be user-friendly, versatile, and reproducible for researchers assembling new genomes.
